result_summary.title: Certificate expired warning in Secret Store
result_summary.description: We are seeing 'certificate expired' warnings in our Secret Store in the APAC production environment. We believe this is definitely a capacity limitation issue where the store is full and can't process the renewal requests properly. We need this resolved as it's affecting about 54 users and causing moderate business impact.
